full_judgment: 17. Coming now to P.W.2 Malu @ Malek, it is an admitted fact that on the date of occurrence, as he said in cross-examination, he worked as a kamla of deceased Jalil in his homestead from sunrise to about 1/1-30 P.M. when he came back to his house. Neighbouring people, namely, Karim, Rashid, knew about it they have not been examined to corroborate this part of his story Jalil picket him up from Shahrail Bazar; half a mile away from Jalil's house at Baliadangi, at 3/3-30 P.M, but this part of the story of P.W.2 is also uncorroborated. While electioneering, the story goes, Jalil sat at the mudi shop of Wazuddin at Shibpur, village and canvassed for Kafiluddin before Kachai, Joinal and some others Who have not been examined to corroborate this part P.W.2 was then taken to Baju Molla's tea stall at Bairagir Tek and was asked to wait for Jalil till he came back from P.W.3 Asia's house on an errand. No one has been examined to corroborate this story, although, everything had been happening in broad daylight and in presence of customers of Baju Mollah's tea stall. After the alleged occurrence, P.W.2 ran away on being threatened by accused Motaleb and he informed Baju Mollah, Rafiq Chairman and many others of whom Baju Molla and Rafiq Ahmed were cited in the charge sheet as witnesses. They have not been examined without any explanation. It is, therefore not proved at all that he informed anyone of the occurrence. He gave out in cross-examination that he informed about the murder of Jalil to the neighboring people surrounding Baju Mollah's shop and those people subsequently had gone to the P.W and saw the dead body of Jalil. These neighboring people have not been examined to land him support. There is absolutely no corroborative evidence whatsoever that P.W.2 accompanied deceased Jalil in the election campaign on the day of occurrence, that he went to Shibpur with him, sat at Baju Mollah's shop while waiting for Jalil to return, saw the occurrence or informed anybody of the occurrence.
